text: Management Science and Engineering is an interdisciplinary field that integrates management studies, economics, mathematics, and computer science. Its core lies in solving complex management problems through "scientific methods", emphasizing the use of quantitative analysis, model construction, and data-driven approaches to optimize the decision-making process and enhance organizational efficiency and system performance. From optimizing the supply chain of enterprises, managing project schedules, to regulating traffic flow in smart cities and allocating resources in national energy systems, all of these rely on the theoretical and methodological support of this discipline.
